questions.question: Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set. (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.) (2, 39, 45) (10, 32, 62)
questions.questionHtml:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)

(2, 39, 45)

(10, 32, 62)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : (3rd number - 2nd number) = (1st number × 3)

Given :

  • (2, 39, 45)

(45 - 39) = (2 × 3)

6 = 6 (LHS = RHS)

  • (10, 32, 62)

(62 - 32) = (10 × 3)

30 = 30 (LHS = RHS)

​So,

  • Option - (1) : (10, 17, 49)​

(49 - 17) = (10 × 3)

32 ≠ 30 (LHS ≠ RHS)
  • Option - (2) : (5, 8, 22)​

(22 - 8) = (5 × 3)

14 ≠ 15 (LHS ≠ RHS)
  • Option - (3) : (3, 7, 16)​

(16 - 7) = (3 × 3)

9 = 9 (LHS = RHS)
  • Option - (4) : (6, 10, 25)​​

(25 - 10) = (6 × 3)

15 ≠ 18 (LHS ≠ RHS)

​Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option which is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term. 41 : 123 : 82 : ?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option which is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

41 : 123 : 82 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Multiply the first number by the difference between its digits, we get the second number.

41 × (4 - 1)

41 × 3

= 123

Similarly, 82 × (8 - 2)

= 82 × 6

= 492

Hence, 492 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number. 7 : 113 :: 11 : ? :: 15 : 481
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

7 : 113 :: 11 : ? :: 15 : 481
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number × ((First number × 2) + 2)) + 1 = Second number

  • 7 : 113 → (7 × ((7 × 2) + 2)) + 1 = (7 × (14 + 2)) + 1 = (7 × 16) + 1 = 112 + 1 = 113
  • 11 : ? → (11 × ((11 × 2) + 2)) + 1 = (11 × (22 + 2)) + 1 = (11 × 24) + 1 = 264 + 1 = 265
  • 15 : 481 → (15 × ((15 × 2) + 2)) + 1 = (15 × (30 + 2)) + 1 = (15 × 32) + 1 = 480 + 1 = 481

Hence, the correct answer is "265".

Alternate Method72 + 82

⇒ 49 + 64 = 113

152 + 162

⇒ 225 + 256

Similarly

112 + 122

⇒ 121 + 144 = 265

questions.question: From the given options choose the one in which the set of numbers do not follow the same Logic/Rule/Relation as the numbers given in below set. (165, 16, 91)
questions.questionHtml:
From the given options choose the one in which the set of numbers do not follow the same Logic/Rule/Relation as the numbers given in below set.

(165, 16, 91)
questions.solution:
Given: (165, 16, 91)

The logic followed here is:

(165, 16, 91) → \(\sqrt{165 + 91} = \sqrt{256} = 16\)

By checking options,

(1) (99, 14, 97) → \(\sqrt{99 + 97} = \sqrt{196} = 14\)

(2) (76, 11, 45) → \(\sqrt{76 + 45} = \sqrt{121} = 11\)

(3) (85, 13, 59) → \(\sqrt{85 + 59} = \sqrt{144} = 12 \neq 13\)

(4) (57, 9, 24) → \(\sqrt{57 + 24} = \sqrt{81} = 9\)

Hence, (85, 13, 59) is the correct answer.

Mistake PointsWe have to find the option that does not follow the same logic that is given in the question.

questions.question: Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number. 23 : 368 :: 25 : ? :: 21 : 294
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

23 : 368 :: 25 : ? :: 21 : 294
questions.solution:
Logic: First number × (First number - 7) = Second number.

23 : 368 → 23 × (23 - 7) = 23 × 16 = 368

21 : 294 → 21 × (21 - 7) = 21 × 14 = 294

25 : ? → 25 × (25 - 7) = 25 × 18 = 450.
